hints.title: Problem Analysis
hints.text: Find the longest strictly increasing prefix [0..p] and longest strictly increasing suffix [s..n-1].

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: If the entire array is already strictly increasing, any subarray removal is valid, giving n * (n + 1) // 2.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy
hints.text: Otherwise, for each valid prefix ending at i (or empty prefix), binary search or use two pointers to find the smallest suffix index j >= s such that nums[i] < nums[j].

hints.title: Implementation

variables: n: size of input array or string
complexity.notes: Efficient execution matching optimal computational complexity.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute force exceeds standard time constraints.
